title: An ninh thông tin (Security Engineer) - TNTech - 2V068
description: 1. Xây dựng các yêu cầu kỹ thuật về hệ thống an ninh thông tin cho tất cả các dự án công nghệ 2. Triển khai hệ thống an ninh thông tin phục vụ các dự án công nghệ. Xây dựng các thiết kế hạ tầng an ninh thông tin phục vụ các dự án liên quan Triển khai hệ thống an ninh thông tin theo thiết kế Tham gia xây dựng kiến trúc an ninh thông tin tổng thể và lộ trình triển khai các hạ tầng công nghệ đồng bộ với kế hoạch kinh doanh của các đơn vị trong tập đoàn 3. Kiểm tra, tiếp nhận các hệ thống an ninh thông tin theo các tiêu chí đã được thống nhất với người sử dụng 4. Vận hành, bảo hành, bảo trì hệ thống an ninh thông tin đáp ứng các thỏa thuận vận hành dịch vụ: Giám sát hoạt động của hệ thống cũng như thực hiện các hoạt động vận hành, bảo hành, bảo trì, nâng cấp các hệ thống công nghệ Đầu mối điều phối các hoạt động và tham gia khắc phục sự cố sự cố an ninh thông tin Tham gia đánh giá rủi ro về an ninh thông tin và đưa ra các kế hoạch cũng như thúc đẩy việc triển khai các giải pháp giảm thiểu rủi ro (bao gồm cả thực hiện Penetration Testing / Vulnerability Scanning) 5. Tham gia xây dựng và triển khai ứng dụng một số quy trình, quy định, tài liệu hướng dẫn, tiêu chuẩn, các công cụ phần mềm nhằm đảm bảo việc vận hành hệ thống an ninh thông tin đáp ứng được yêu cầu hoạt động kinh doanh và tối ưu hiệu quả đầu tư (bao gồm cả các dự án tuân thủ ISO, PCI, hay các tiêu chuẩn ngành khác nếu cần) 6. Tham gia đánh giá nhu cầu sử dụng hệ thống an ninh thông tin của các đơn vị và xây dựng kế hoạch (nguồn lực, ngân sách, tiến độ, giải pháp) nâng cấp, cải thiện hệ thống hàng năm hoặc khi có yêu cầu 7. Tham gia tư vấn, triển khai hạ tầng công nghệ thông tin, mạng và an ninh thông tin cho các đơn vị và Tập đoàn, đảm bảo an ninh thông tin cho các hệ thống trong và ngoài Tập đoàn

title: OT Security Engineer
description: The OT Security Engineer is responsible for securing the airport's operational technology — baggage handling, building management, fire-safety interfaces, physical access control, CCTV, and supporting industrial systems — from design review through commissioning and into operations. Working on the owner's team, the role reviews and challenges the designs delivered by the systems integrator and M&E contractors, verifies security evidence before acceptance, and represents OT security at the project's Architecture Review Board. The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge across ICS and building-automation systems, industrial networking, and OT security frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and CIS Controls — with proven experience in greenfield deployments, design assurance, and security acceptance in critical infrastructure environments. Working proficiency in both Vietnamese and English is required. Key Responsibilities 1. OT Security Architecture Review & Assurance Review the systems integrator's HLD/LLD network and security designs for the OT scope: zones and conduits per IEC 62443, firewall placement, and segmentation between IT, OT, and public-facing networks. Verify with L2/L3 evidence — VLAN, SVI, and routing records, management-plane and PAM design, wireless isolation proof — that no protected flow bypasses the designated firewalls. Review OT remote-access and patching paths (jump host, patch staging) to ensure no uncontrolled IT-to OT connectivity emerges. Track findings to closure through the project's decision and gap registers, distinguishing design risk from evidence gap. 2. Airport OT Systems & Safety Boundaries Own the OT security view of the airport systems: baggage handling (BHS), building management (BMS/HVAC), fire alarm (monitor-only integration), physical access control (PACS), CCTV, master clock, lifts and escalators, and power management. Defend safety boundaries: hardwired interlocks sit below the software layer and must remain independent of any network or command path. Participate in FAT/SAT/SIT and commissioning: witness command-verification, failuremode, and interlock override testing with the M&E contractors and the Commissioning Authority, and hold security acceptance criteria at each gate through ORAT. 3. Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Alignment Apply IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and CIS Controls pragmatically to an airport OT environment. Operate within Vietnam's regulatory framework for critical information infrastructure: the Law on Cybersecurity, Decree 53, and personal data protection requirements, including reporting relationships with CAAV and the Ministry of Public Security. Prepare and defend OT security positions at the Architecture Review Board; produce documentation in both English and Vietnamese for the architecture team, contractors, and authorities. 4. OT Visibility, Monitoring & SOC Integration Build and maintain a comprehensive OT asset inventory (wired, wireless, and IIoT) as the foundation for segmentation and monitoring decisions. Define requirements and acceptance criteria for passive OT network monitoring and anomaly detection, evaluating platforms capability-first: asset-discovery depth, protocol coverage, and SIEM export quality. Integrate OT telemetry into the enterprise SIEM (Splunk-based), and define alert ownership together with the SOC and the operations team. 5. Secure Procurement & Supplier Gating Write capability-based security requirements for OT procurements and assess supplier responses. Operate device compliance questionnaires as procurement gates: protocol conformance, TLS support, authenticated access, safe-state behaviour on loss of communications, and interlock independence. Define proof-of-concept scope and acceptance criteria before any monitoring or enforcement platform is purchased. 6. Wireless & IIoT Security Review wireless designs for the OT estate and verify isolation evidence for guest and public Wi-Fi against corporate and OT networks (WLC placement, SSID/VLAN separation, 802.1X, WPA3-Enterprise). Assess IIoT and telemetry radio proposals (LoRa, private 5G) as they arise, including Vietnamese spectrum constraints. 7. Emerging OT Platform Security Contribute to security review of the next-phase OT platform: Unified Namespace (MQTT/Sparkplug B, OPC UA, Kafka), IT/OT Bridge with hardware data diode, and IEC 61499 software-defined automation — including engineering and deployment-plane security, recovery and IEC 61131-3 fallback, and autonomy governance.
requirements_raw: Qualifications & Requirements Education Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial or Control Engineering, or equivalent experience. Experience Min 3–5 years in OT/ICS security, industrial networking, or building-automation security. Experience in airports, critical infrastructure, or large campus environments strongly preferred; greenfield construction-phase experience is a significant advantage. Languages Vietnamese and English at working proficiency (required). Certifications (Preferred) ISA/IEC 62443 Expert / Practitioner, SANS GICSP, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CWSP / CWNA (for wireless OT). Technical Competencies Proficient in BACnet/IP (mandatory building-systems protocol on this project), OPC UA, and IP networking and firewalling in segmented OT environments; TLS/PKI fundamentals. Working knowledge of MQTT/Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP (legacy-exception handling), and industrial wireless security. Hands-on experience with at least one passive OT monitoring / asset-discovery platform (e.g., Forescout, Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis). Experience with enterprise SIEM (Splunk preferred), EDR in mixed IT/OT estates, and firewall review at both rulebase and architecture level. Familiarity with PLC/controller ecosystems (Schneider, Siemens, Rockwell) and exposure to IEC 61499 / IEC 61131-3 concepts. Familiar with risk management, threat modeling, and incident response for OT systems. Soft Skills Evidence-driven mindset: comfortable withholding acceptance until proof is provided, and able to state precisely what evidence would close a finding. Able to hold a security position under pressure from vendors or contractors, and to revise it when the evidence changes. Balances security rigour with operational uptime and a fixed opening date. Strong documentation habits: registers, decision records, and review comments that others can act on. Clear communication and stakeholder coordination across engineering, operations, and regulatory audiences.

Prototype ideas quickly, iterate based on feedback, and deliver meaningful product impact. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Growth, and Engineering teams to continuously improve the user experience. Use data, monitoring, observability, and investigation tools to support technical and product decisions. Use AI tools and agents throughout the engineering lifecycle, including coding, architecture, debugging, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, technical investigation, and code review. Manage multiple AI-assisted tasks or agents in parallel by delegating effectively, preserving context, validating outputs, and integrating results into production-quality solutions. Chuẩn bị hồ sơ, tài liệu và bằng chứng phục vụ công tác kiểm toán, đánh giá nội bộ, đánh giá bên ngoài và thanh tra. Tổ chức các chương trình đào tạo, truyền thông nhằm nâng cao nhận thức về an toàn thông tin trong toàn công ty. title: Senior/Tech Lead (.NET or Nodejs)
location: Quận Tân Bình, Hồ Chí Minh
description: We are looking for a talented Senior/Tech Lead with strong .NET or Node.js foundations and solid cloud experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our web and cloud-based applications while helping the team embrace a more AI-augmented way of working. You don’t need to be an AI expert – but you should be curious, hands-on, and open to using tools like agentic coding assistants and spec-driven workflows to raise the bar on how software gets built. We value engineers who can think independently, collaborate well, and bring pragmatic judgment to both technical decisions and the evolving AI landscape. Your Role Designing, developing, and implementing software architecture solutions using either .NET or Node.js frameworks. Leading the technical design process, ensuring alignment with business goals, and translating requirements into scalable technical solutions with stakeholders. Leading the spec-driven development practices (OpenSpec, SpecKit, OpenAPI, or similar) so that requirements and API contracts are well-defined and AI-consumable before implementation begins. Encouraging the team to adopt agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot / Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Cursor, etc.) and identifying where AI can add value at each SDLC phase – from design and coding to testing and deployment. Reviewing AI-generated code and artifacts for quality, correctness, and security – applying critical judgment on hallucinations, data exposure risks, and scope drift. Providing technical leadership and mentoring to software development teams, fostering good engineering practices alongside responsible AI usage. Evaluating and recommending tools, technologies, and processes to ensure the highest quality product platform. Staying current with emerging AI tooling and industry trends, and bringing relevant advances back to the team in practical ways.
requirements_raw: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field. At least 7 years of hands-on software development experience, with solid expertise in either .NET or Node.js (Express, Nest.js) frameworks. Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale systems from scratch, with a strong grasp of system architecture and design. Familiarity with modern architecture principles and patterns: Serverless, Domain-Driven Design, Microservices, Clean Architecture, CQRS. Some exposure to spec-driven or specification-first workflows (OpenAPI, OpenSpec, SpecKit, or equivalent) – curiosity and willingness to go deeper counts. Working familiarity with at least one agentic AI development tool (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot / Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Cursor, etc.) and an interest in expanding this across the SDLC. Practical awareness of AI limitations – hallucination, data leakage to cloud-hosted models, prompt injection, and over-reliance – and a sensible approach to mitigating them in day-to-day development. Expertise in one of the cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native architecture; cloud architecture certification is a plus. Strong experience with DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment processes. Good communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor developers and guide teams to successful outcomes.

title: Senior Embedded Software (C/C++, AUTOSAR, firmware)

title: Senior Data Analyst (Gaming)
description: This position will play a critical role in driving the success of our game publishing operations by staying ahead of market trends, identifying high-potential games, and crafting strategies to source and evaluate game deals. This position requires a deep understanding of the mobile gaming industry, analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate with internal teams to align market insights with company goals. Key Responsibilities: BI Systems & Data Strategy: Architect BI Solutions: Lead the design and implementation of a centralized Business Intelligence system, collaborating with Data Engineers to ensure data pipelines accurately capture KPIs across game performance, user acquisition, and monetization. Power BI Ecosystem: Build, maintain, and optimize a suite of automated Power BI dashboards that provide real-time visibility into portfolio health for Technical, Marketing, and Product teams. Data Governance: Work with the technical team to define data schemas and ensure "one version of the truth" across all cross-functional reports. Game Evaluation & Deal Assessment: Evaluate submitted or scouted game proposals based on market fit, scalability, monetization potential, and alignment with company objectives. Collaborate with the operations and finance teams to assess the feasibility and ROI of potential game publishing deals. Provide detailed reports and recommendations to leadership on which games to pursue. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure sourced games align with promotional capabilities and technical requirements. Share insights and updates with the broader team to foster a data-driven approach to game publishing. Reporting Structure: Reports directly to the Head of Operations in Vietnam. Collaborates with marketing, finance, and product teams. Location: Ho Chi Minh City
requirements_raw: Hardcore gamer who plays a lot of mobile genres. Proven experience (3-5+ years) in the mobile gaming industry, preferably in market analysis, game publishing, or a related field. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable strategies. Deep knowledge of mobile game trends, genres, and monetization models (e.g., in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions). Excellent communication and negotiation skills to liaise with developers and internal stakeholders. Familiarity with the Vietnamese gaming market and its unique characteristics and gaming metrics such as ROI / ROAS / Retention … is a plus. Advanced Analytics: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python for data extraction and Power BI (DAX/Power Query) for complex data modeling and visualization. Familiar working with 3rd parties mobile game analytics platforms (e.g., App Annie, Sensor Tower, Firebase and MMP such as Adjust / Appsflyer). Proficiency in English.

requirements_raw: Tốt nghiệp đại học trở lên ngành: CNTT, kỹ sư máy tính, HTTT, Toán kinh tế,... title: Lead Penetration Tester (Pentester)
description: ITviec's client is an AI-centric global digital transformation company. We design advanced data and AI transformation solutions, modernize technology architectures and develop next-generation core systems for industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing and Robotics. Partnering closely with our clients, we push boundaries to unlock their full potential. As a Lead Penetration Tester, you will be responsible for leading and performing authorized security testing activities across applications, digital platforms, APIs, infrastructure, cloud environments, and related systems. This role is designed as a hands-on technical leadership position, with approximately 70% focus on penetration testing execution and 30% focus on leading, guiding, reviewing, and coordinating security testing activities. The role focuses on identifying security vulnerabilities, validating risks, supporting remediation, and ensuring that systems meet security, regulatory, and industry requirements. You will be expected to act as a senior technical expert, providing direction on testing approach, reviewing findings, mentoring team members, and ensuring high-quality penetration testing deliverables. You will work closely with security teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, DevOps, architects, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to plan and perform penetration testing across web, mobile, API, cloud, and network environments. The role requires strong hands-on technical security skills, practical experience in ethical hacking, and the ability to communicate security risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role requires the candidate to work onsite at the client’s office based on project needs and client requirements. The onsite frequency, working schedule, location, and duration will be aligned with the client’s expectations and may vary depending on the project phase, testing activities, stakeholder meetings, security assessment timeline, and remediation support needs. Key Activities Hands-on Penetration Testing Perform authorized penetration testing for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, infrastructure, cloud environments, and digital platforms. Identify, validate, exploit where appropriate, and document security vulnerabilities, including authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, encryption, access control, and business logic issues. Conduct security assessments based on industry standards such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide, and relevant security practices. Analyze application flows, user journeys, transaction processes, access controls, and data handling mechanisms to identify potential security risks. Perform vulnerability assessment and manual verification to reduce false positives and confirm actual exploitability in authorized environments. Conduct retesting activities to validate remediation effectiveness and ensure vulnerabilities are properly resolved. Support security testing activities within the SDLC, including security requirement review, threat analysis, test planning, and release security validation. Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, security risks, and security testing best practices. Technical Leadership & Delivery Support Lead the planning, scoping, and execution of penetration testing activities across assigned projects or workstreams. Define penetration testing approach, test strategy, testing scope, priorities, timelines, and required evidence based on project and client requirements. Guide and mentor penetration testers or security engineers in testing methodology, vulnerability validation, reporting quality, and remediation discussions. Review vulnerability findings, risk ratings, evidence, and remediation recommendations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and practical value. Act as the main technical point of contact for penetration testing activities, working with client stakeholders, security teams, development teams, DevOps, infrastructure teams, and compliance teams. Facilitate vulnerability walkthroughs, risk clarification sessions, remediation discussions, and retesting alignment with relevant stakeholders. Support estimation, planning, status tracking, issue escalation, and delivery reporting for security testing activities. Contribute to improving security testing processes, reporting templates, testing checklists, knowledge sharing, and reusable testing practices. Support regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements by providing security testing evidence, reports, remediation status, and technical clarification when needed.
requirements_raw: Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, ethical hacking, and security testing across application, API, mobile, network, and cloud environments. Proven experience leading or coordinating penetration testing activities, including test planning, execution tracking, finding review, stakeholder communication, and retesting coordination. Strong knowledge of web and API security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10, API authentication, authorization, token handling, insecure direct object references, injection, broken access control, and business logic flaws. Experience testing iOS and Android applications, including mobile application security controls, local storage, certificate pinning, authentication, session handling, and secure communication. Experience in assessing network services, servers, operating systems, misconfigurations, access controls, and common infrastructure vulnerabilities. Familiarity with cloud security concepts and security testing considerations for AWS, Azure, or GCP environments. Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit, Wireshark, Postman, MobSF, or equivalent security testing tools. Ability to independently validate vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, determine business impact, and provide clear remediation recommendations. Ability to write and review clear security reports, including vulnerability details, risk ratings, technical evidence, business impact, and remediation guidance. Ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear, structured, and practical manner. Ability to work with engineering teams to clarify root causes, support fix implementation, and perform retesting. Good understanding of secure coding principles, data privacy, encryption, identity and access management, and common security frameworks. Understanding of security requirements in regulated, audit, or compliance-driven environments. Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple testing activities in parallel. Excellent English communication skills are required, with the ability to communicate fluently and confidently with client stakeholders, security teams, business users, and technical teams. Nice-to-have Requirements Prior experience working on penetration testing or security assessment projects for banks, fintechs, payment platforms, card systems, or financial institutions. Good understanding of banking systems, digital banking, payments, cards, customer onboarding, AML/KYC, fraud management, account services, and transaction flows. Familiarity with banking security practices and financial industry security requirements. Familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SWIFT Customer Security Controls Framework, local banking regulations, or other financial industry security requirements. Experience conducting secure code review or working with SAST tools to identify security issues in application code. Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with tools such as SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, or secrets detection. Familiarity with cloud misconfiguration assessment, container security, Kubernetes security, Docker security, and infrastructure-as-code security checks. Experience with controlled red team exercises, attack simulation, phishing simulation, or adversary emulation in authorized environments. Ability to use Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages to automate testing, validation, or reporting tasks. Experience building security testing methodology, playbooks, checklists, report templates, or quality review practices. Experience mentoring junior or mid-level penetration testers and supporting capability development within a security testing team. Relevant certifications such as CEH, eJPT, PNPT, OSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are preferred.

An ninh Hạ tầng Cloud & Platform Thiết kế và rà soát các chốt chặn an ninh trên Cloud (GCP/AWS), hướng tới quản trị Multi-cloud bền vững. Tư vấn triển khai chuyên sâu về IAM Hardening, Network Security, Workload Isolation và Data Protection. Đảm bảo an ninh cho môi trường Kubernetes, Container Platform và hạ tầng mã hoá (IaC). 4. Quản trị Rủi ro, Tuân thủ & Công nghệ Mới Đảm bảo an ninh dữ liệu và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2). Nghiên cứu và đánh giá rủi ro cho các công nghệ tiên phong: AI/ML Security, Blockchain, Automation. Dẫn dắt các hoạt động Security Research, chia sẻ tri thức và xây dựng cộng đồng bảo mật nội bộ. 5. Dẫn dắt & Phát triển Năng lực (Leadership & Enablement) Cố vấn (Mentor) và phát triển chuyên môn cho các thành viên trong đội ngũ Security. Xây dựng hệ thống Playbook, Security Patterns và hướng dẫn lập trình an toàn (Secure Coding Practices). Thúc đẩy văn hoá an ninh thông tin xuyên suốt các đơn vị kinh doanh và khối kỹ thuật.
requirements_raw: II: Yêu cầu Năng lực 1: Tiêu chuẩn Bắt buộc (Must-have) Tối thiểu 6 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên sâu trong lĩnh vực Security Engineering / Product Security / Cloud Security. Có ít nhất 3 năm đảm nhiệm vai trò Lead, Expert hoặc Senior IC với khả năng dẫn dắt kỹ thuật độc lập. Am hiểu sâu sắc về Threat Modeling, Secure Design Review và Vulnerability Management. Kinh nghiệm thực chiến về Cloud Security (GCP/AWS), Kubernetes và DevSecOps Automation. Kỹ năng giao tiếp chiến lược, có khả năng thuyết phục và làm việc hiệu quả với các Stakeholders cấp cao. 2: Lợi thế Ưu tiên (Nice-to-have) Chứng chỉ quốc tế uy tín: CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, eMAPT, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer. title: Security Specialist (EDR, IAM, Networking)
description: Why We Are Hiring We are hiring one Security Specialist to strengthen and grow the Corporate Security & Governance function at MFV. This person will: Take over and run the routine corporate security and governance operations currently handled by the Money Forward Japan (MFJ) side, and operate them locally at MFV. Gradually build up expertise and, over time, take ownership of security incident handling, focused primarily on MFV. Work alongside the existing security members to drive security improvements at MFV, collaborating on security education and training tailored to MFV’s current situation. About the CISO Office With the mission “Maximize the value we deliver to customers through security,” the CISO Office defines how security should work across the entire Money Forward group. Keeping services running and preventing information leaks matter deeply—but they are only part of what we care about. Excessive security controls can slow development and reduce or delay the value we deliver to customers. As security professionals, we constantly weigh risk and design the security that is genuinely optimal for our customers. Our security principles Embedded security in business strategy — Security is never considered in isolation. We design security measures together with the business strategy: the current business phase, cost, expected future revenue scale, and the potential losses if a risk materializes. Advanced balancing between security and experience — The strongest possible security is not always the right answer, as it raises cost and can harm usability. We assess risk and choose the optimal measures—sometimes taking on risk to pursue maximum user value—and drive automation to reconcile usability and security at a high level. Autonomous and scalable security organization — As the group’s development organization grows, a CISO Office that owns every security function would become a bottleneck. Each development team must be able to build secure services autonomously, and the CISO Office builds the mechanisms and support that make this possible. What You Will Do Drawing on your knowledge and experience in information security, coding, and infrastructure, you will maintain and improve Money Forward’s security in close collaboration with the Global IT department and the CISO Office. Your responsibilities include: Work closely with and report to the CISO Office in Japan on corporate security and security governance, ensuring effective cross-border collaboration—and, through this, contribute to group-wide (global) security matters. Take over routine corporate security and governance operations from the MFJ side and run them locally at MFV. Operate and manage security tooling such as EDR, SWG/DLP, and MDM. Perform security risk management for internal systems and external SaaS usage. Build controls that comply with security guidelines and governance requirements. Respond to security incidents for internal systems, progressively taking ownership of incident handling at MFV. Plan and drive device security measures. Implement and roll out frameworks such as NIST CSF and CIS Benchmarks. Gather information on and validate new technologies from major vendors (e.g., Microsoft). Collaborate with the existing to design and deliver security education and training suited to MFV’s situation.
requirements_raw: Required Skills & Experience Solid foundational understanding of computer science, including networking, operating systems, data structures, and cryptography. Development experience in at least one programming language. Hands-on experience building and operating internal systems (e.g., MDM, EDR, Entra ID). Experience building and operating security appliances (Firewall, IDS/IPS, etc.) and network equipment. Business-level English for professional communication with the Japan-based team and for documentation. Preferred Skills & Experience Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or GCIH. Deep understanding of authentication and authorization, OIDC, and OAuth. Experience with security-related work in the finance / fintech industry (e.g., FISC and similar standards). Experience developing AI, or developing with the help of AI tools. (As shared in Money Forward AI Vision 2025, Money Forward is actively using AI to improve operational efficiency and expects to introduce AI agents across all products in the future.)

description: CMC TS đang xây dựng và phát triển năng lực AI-X (AI Transformation) nhằm cung cấp dịch vụ chuyển đổi AI toàn diện cho các khách hàng doanh nghiệp tại Việt Nam và khu vực. Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một Chief AI Transformation Officer (CAITO) có tầm nhìn chiến lược, kinh nghiệm thực tiễn sâu rộng về Data & AI, năng lực lãnh đạo đội ngũ quy mô lớn và khả năng làm việc trực tiếp với lãnh đạo cấp cao của khách hàng. CAITO sẽ là người chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng, phát triển và vận hành toàn bộ mảng kinh doanh AI Transformation của CMC TS, bao gồm tư vấn chiến lược AI, nền tảng dữ liệu, nền tảng AI, phát triển các AI use case, đào tạo, chuyển giao và vận hành tối ưu hệ thống AI cho khách hàng. Đây là vị trí lãnh đạo cấp cao trong BOM, đóng vai trò xây dựng năng lực cốt lõi và tạo động lực tăng trưởng chiến lược cho công ty trong giai đoạn phát triển tiếp theo. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Xây dựng và dẫn dắt chiến lược AI Transformation Xây dựng chiến lược phát triển AI Transformation của CMC TS. Xây dựng danh mục giải pháp và dịch vụ AI-X. Định nghĩa phương pháp luận (Methodology) triển khai AI Transformation cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp. Xây dựng các framework đánh giá mức độ sẵn sàng về AI (AI Readiness Assessment). Tư vấn chiến lược AI cho khách hàng cấp C-Level. 2. Phát triển danh mục dịch vụ AI-X Chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng và hoàn thiện các nhóm dịch vụ: AI Strategy & Consulting AI Strategy AI Roadmap AI Governance Responsible AI AI Operating Model AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) Data Platform & Governance Data Strategy Data Governance Data Lake / Lakehouse Data Warehouse Master Data Management Data Quality Management Enterprise AI Platform GenAI Platform Agentic AI Platform RAG Platform Knowledge Management Platform MLOps / LLMOps AI Monitoring & Governance AI Applications & Use Cases trong nhiều lĩnh vực khác nhau: Enterprise GPT AI Knowledge Assistant AI Customer Service AI Sales Assistant AI Financial Assistant AI Risk & Fraud Analytics Predictive Analytics Industry-specific AI Solutions 3. Thiết kế kiến trúc tổng thể sản phẩm Xây dựng kiến trúc tham chiếu (Reference Architecture) cho các ngành: Banking and Financial Services; Manufacturing ; Retail; Healthcare;Government … Định hướng công nghệ và kiến trúc AI (Cloud, Hybrid, Private) ; Các giải pháp về Sovereign AI ; kiến trúc Multi-Agent Systems ; Kiến trúc tich hợp hệ thống ; Enterprise Knowledge Graph ; AI Security 4. Lãnh đạo Delivery và đảm bảo chất lượng triển khai Thiết lập mô hình quản trị các dự án Data & AI. Xây dựng các tiêu chuẩn triển khai, vận hành và kiểm soát chất lượng. Tham gia định hướng các chương trình chuyển đổi AI chiến lược. Giám sát các dự án AI trọng điểm với vai trò Executive Sponsor hoặc Chief Architect. 5. Xây dựng và phát triển đội ngũ AI Xây dựng AI Practice của CMC TS. Tuyển dụng, dẫn dắt, đào tạo và tổ chức đội ngũ: AI Consultants , Data Consultants , AI Architects , Data Architects , Data Engineers , AI Engineers , MLOps Engineers … Thiết lập hệ thống năng lực, lộ trình nghề nghiệp và chương trình phát triển chuyên gia AI. 6. Hỗ trợ kinh doanh và phát triển thị trường Làm việc cùng Sales và Account Teams trong các cơ hội kinh doanh chiến lược. Tham gia xây dựng giải pháp, proposal và thuyết trình với cấp CEO, CIO, CDO, CTO. Đầu mối làm việc với các hãng, đối tác công nghệ toàn cầu trong lĩnh vực AI Tham gia các hội thảo, diễn đàn, sự kiện ngành trong và ngoài nước với vai trò diễn giả hoặc chuyên gia

title: Senior Database Administrator (PostgreSQL, AWS, Agile)
description: Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently. Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years. About the role As a Senior Database Engineer , you will own the database platform from architecture through operations, enabling product teams to build reliable, data-intensive applications and AI-powered capabilities. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about cloud-native infrastructure, database performance, automation, and modern data platforms. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate Katalon's database platform with a focus on scalability, availability, security, and performance. Architect, provision, and manage PostgreSQL databases on AWS Aurora for mission-critical production systems. Build and maintain reusable database platform capabilities, including provisioning, backup & recovery, monitoring, observability, disaster recovery, and self-service tooling. Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption to automate database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. Optimize database performance through schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, partitioning, replication, and capacity planning. Implement and maintain PostgreSQL Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), managing roles, grants, schema privileges, and least-privilege access across production and multi-tenant environments. Collaborate with Software Engineers and Platform teams to design scalable and reliable data architectures for SaaS products. Establish database standards, governance, security policies, backup strategies, and operational best practices across engineering teams. Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term improvements to platform reliability. Lead database upgrades, migrations, and platform modernization initiatives with minimal service disruption.
requirements_raw: Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in Database Engineering, Database Administration, Platform Engineering, or Backend Engineering with strong database expertise. Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including replication, performance tuning, indexing, backup & recovery, partitioning, and high availability. Experience managing cloud-native database services, preferably AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS. Strong SQL skills with the ability to optimize complex, high-volume production workloads. Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to provision and manage database infrastructure. Strong experience with PostgreSQL Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), including managing roles, grants, schema privileges, and applying least-privilege principles across production and multi-tenant environments. Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems and cloud infrastructure. Experience working in modern CI/CD, DevOps, and Platform Engineering environments. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and system design skills. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience building automation tools and operational scripts using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages. Experience with PostgreSQL extensions such as pgvector , PostGIS , or TimescaleDB . Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized environments. Experience with data warehousing technologies such as Amazon Redshift. AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform, or Kubernetes certifications. Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer (Cloud) - ID8203
description: Triển khai các elements cần thiết để xây dựng và vận hành môi trường bảo mật trên nền tảng Cloud. Xây dựng kiến trúc bảo mật nền tảng (baseline security architecture) và các tiêu chuẩn cấu hình bảo mật cho môi trường Public Cloud cũng như các dịch vụ vận hành trên đó (ví dụ: network, firewall, OS, middleware, v.v.). Đánh giá các công nghệ, công cụ và dịch vụ bảo mật; theo dõi xu hướng thị trường và đưa ra các khuyến nghị cho đội ngũ CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence) và các nhóm phát triển khác. Xác định, ghi nhận các rủi ro bảo mật trên môi trường Cloud và xây dựng kế hoạch giảm thiểu/khắc phục tương ứng. Xây dựng các tiêu chuẩn, quy trình tốt nhất về bảo mật, phối hợp cùng đội ngũ An toàn thông tin (Security Team). Giám sát và theo dõi mọi thay đổi trên môi trường Public Cloud nhằm đảm bảo tuân thủ chiến lược và các tiêu chuẩn bảo mật đã được ban hành. Theo dõi quá trình triển khai để đảm bảo các giải pháp tuân thủ chiến lược và tiêu chuẩn bảo mật do các nhóm EA (Enterprise Architecture), Security và CCoE đề ra. Đảm bảo tất cả các triển khai trên Public Cloud được tích hợp đúng cách với các công cụ bảo mật và giám sát, đồng thời được theo dõi đầy đủ thông qua các hệ thống như SIEM, NOC, SOC, v.v. Phối hợp với các nhóm DevOps để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng Secure Coding Practices, đồng thời báo cáo và nâng cấp các vấn đề liên quan đến chất lượng mã nguồn hoặc chất lượng code chưa đảm bảo an toàn tới CCoE, EA và CISO. Tư vấn cho các nhóm phát triển về các tiêu chuẩn và quy tắc bảo mật trong quá trình thiết kế, phát triển và vận hành hệ thống.

Có kiến thức về các lĩnh vực bảo mật như Network Security, IAM, WAF, SIEM, Endpoint Security, Cloud Security hoặc tương đương. title: AI QA & Data Quality Specialist (Hybrid QA)
description: We are seeking an AI QA & Data Quality Specialist to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of AI-driven products and the data pipelines that support them. This role focuses on validating AI model outputs, testing AI-powered features, and ensuring the integrity and quality of datasets and data pipelines used for training and inference. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, and product teams to improve the overall quality of AI systems through systematic testing, data validation, and automation. Key Responsibilities AI System Quality Assurance Design and execute test strategies for AI/ML-powered applications and features. Validate AI model outputs for accuracy, reliability, and consistency. Perform prompt testing, response evaluation, and edge case validation for AI systems. Identify issues such as hallucinations, bias, incorrect reasoning, or unstable responses Define acceptance criteria and quality benchmarks for AI-driven features. Data Engineering & Data Pipeline Testing Validate data pipelines (ETL/ELT) used to prepare datasets for AI models. Test data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes to ensure reliability. Verify data integrity between source systems, data warehouses, and AI models. Detects and reports data anomalies, schema changes, missing data, or transformation errors. Create data validation rules and automated data quality checks. Dataset & Model Evaluation Validate training datasets and feature engineering pipelines. Monitor dataset quality to prevent data drift or unexpected data changes. Define and track AI model evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and response quality. Collaborate with data scientists to analyze model performance and identify improvement areas. Test Automation Develop automated tests for AI APIs, workflows, and data pipelines. Build automation frameworks to test AI output regression and data validation. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Collaboration & Process Improvement Work closely with AI engineers, data engineers, product managers, and QA teams. Provide feedback during AI model development and deployment cycles. Contribute to building AI testing standards, data quality guidelines, and QA best practices.
requirements_raw: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 5+ years of experience in software QA, test automation, or data validation and 2+ years of experience in AI & Data quality testing Experience testing APIs, web services, or distributed systems. Strong knowledge of SQL and data validation techniques. Strong with Python for data automation, typescript and or Java for other automation. Understanding of machine learning concepts and AI system behavior. Experience with test automation tools. Experience testing AI systems, LLM applications, or chatbots. Experience with big data platforms. Knowledge of prompt engineering or AI evaluation methods. Experience working with cloud platforms AWS Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices. Generative AI: Enthusiastic user of Generative AI and advanced AI tooling to streamline workflows and significantly accelerate project delivery timelines. Product Mindset: Proven track record to translate high-level product requirements into detailed requirements, and into comprehensive technical requirements through close partnership with Product Managers Communication: Good verbal and written English skills, ensuring clarity and alignment within distributed, multi-national product engineering teams. Key Skills AI/ML testing Data pipeline testing Data quality validation SQL and dataset analysis Test automation API testing Prompt evaluation Data integrity verification Success Metrics Improved AI output quality and reliability (accuracy rate, latency, token, cost,...) Early detection of data pipeline or dataset issues Increased automation coverage for AI and data testing Reduced production issues caused by data or AI failures

title: Junior Backend Developer (Wordpress / PHP)
description: Entry-level developer who supports the Middle Fullstack Developer on the production WordPress plugin that powers live Quality Realty tenants today. You implement small features , bug fixes , and tests in PHP and wp-admin JavaScript, and help integrate admin-side changes (including CCI-related UI hooks) under close review. This is a transition role : the long-term web stack is React/Next.js ; you strengthen the legacy runway , not the final platform choice. Current engineering phase Revenue and operations depend on the WordPress plugin and REST API /wp-json/qr/v3 . New Python/FastAPI services are added alongside using a strangler-fig approach. You work mainly in PHP/MySQL and admin UI; you do not own mobile ( Flutter ) or the future Next.js admin app. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) — a voice-first, multilingual platform that connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Fix bugs from the backlog: reproduce issues, patch PHP/plugin code, verify on staging where available. Implement small, scoped features in the WordPress plugin (PHP) and wp-admin front-end (JavaScript/jQuery patterns used in the codebase) under Middle Fullstack review. Write and improve unit tests and simple integration checks for code you touch. Respect multi-tenant patterns (organization_id, roles/capabilities); never break cross-tenant isolation. Follow additive-only database and API changes unless explicitly approved; protect /wp-json/qr/v3 backward compatibility. Assist with CCI admin integration tasks (screens, hooks, REST wiring) as specified by the Tech Lead. Support retargeting , widget orders , AI Flow / prompt UI tasks when prioritized by BA and Tech Lead. Participate in code reviews , Git pull requests, and team standards; learn WordPress and plugin architecture from Middle and Tech Lead. Document what you change (short PR descriptions, handover notes) so future Next.js migration is easier. Do not own Python services, Flutter mobile, or greenfield architecture decisions

SQL basics (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE; simple joins). Git : branches, pull requests, readable commits. Good English for team chat, PR descriptions, and reading specs. Strong willingness to learn , accept feedback, and work in a small team. Nice to have Exposure to REST APIs (consuming or extending). Basic Python (helps communication with Junior Backend track). Awareness of Sentry , logging, or debugging production issues. Interest in real estate or marketplace products. Prior WordPress plugin (not only theme) experience.

title: Data Scientist (AI & Real Estate Valuation)
description: Role summary Data scientist who owns the development, validation, and ongoing improvement of AI prediction models for current and future real estate valuations in the Netherlands. You strengthen the intelligence layer behind the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its resellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — turning Dutch property data (and realtor-uploaded history) into trustworthy valuations and forecasts for realtors, vendors, and clients. Current engineering phase Production valuations today use the Altum AI API integrated in the live WordPress plugin. Early months focus on data audit, Excel ingest design, baselines, and experimentation ; heavier ETL (Airflow) and production ML serving ramp in the second half of the 6-month plan. Target accuracy: MAPE < 6–8% on hold-out data where feasible. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. Funda/Pararius ingestion only where legally approved (may be deferred for MVP). Perform feature engineering , including geospatial work (e.g. geopy/geopandas), temporal lags, economic adjustments (interest rates, inflation), and Dutch-specific factors ( energy labels , postcode granularity, house age, WOZ influence). Design, train, and iterate on ML models for property valuation ( XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM ) and, where scoped, time-series forecasting ( LSTM, Prophet , or hybrid approaches) targeting MAPE < 6–8% on hold-out and realistic test sets. Benchmark against the existing Altum integration so we can switch or A/B without regressing tenant-facing quality. Conduct rigorous evaluation : cross-validation, backtesting against historical Dutch market shifts, and monitoring for concept drift (e.g. post-2022 rate changes, energy transition). Apply explainability ( SHAP, LIME ) so product and voice flows can surface understandable drivers (e.g. location, energy label contributions). Integrate models into the Python backend (FastAPI) for batch and real-time inference, working with the Middle Fullstack Developer and Junior Backend Developer on reliable, low-latency serving. Automate retraining pipelines ( Cloud Composer / Airflow ) and contribute to the ETL layer so models receive fresh data. Analyze errors, market trends, and feedback; propose improvements (e.g. renovation scenarios, risk flags, personalized insights). Document models, experiments, feature importance, and data usage for GDPR , internal knowledge sharing, and future white-label use. Partner with the Tech Lead on model selection, architecture, and scalability; support data-science best practices across the team as it grows.

Strong Python for data science ( pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM ; TensorFlow/PyTorch or statsmodels as needed). Solid experience with regression and preferably time-series forecasting ; geospatial skills (geopandas, geopy) a significant plus. Proven ability to clean and merge large, messy datasets, handle outliers, and engineer features that improve accuracy. Practical knowledge of MAPE, RMSE, MAE , hyperparameter tuning ( Optuna , GridSearch), cross-validation, and explainable AI ( SHAP, LIME ). Comfortable with SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and Git . Strong analytical mindset; ability to translate real estate and business problems into data-driven solutions. Eagerness to work in a small startup, iterate quickly, and take ownership of outcomes. Thành thạo Docker, CI/CD và quy trình phát triển phần mềm hiện đại. Có khả năng phân tích, giải quyết vấn đề và làm việc độc lập. Ưu tiên Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng hệ thống Realtime sử dụng WebSocket, Streaming hoặc Message Queue. Có kinh nghiệm với Elasticsearch hoặc các hệ thống tìm kiếm tương tự. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Kubernetes, Terraform hoặc Infrastructure as Code. Đã từng tham gia thiết kế kiến trúc hoặc dẫn dắt kỹ thuật cho dự án. Có kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực Mobility, Mapping, Navigation, Logistics, Fintech, IoT hoặc AI Platform. Có kinh nghiệm mentoring hoặc technical leadership.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: ABOUT FPT SOFTWARE FPT Software, a subsidiary of FPT Group, is a leading global IT service provider headquartered in Vietnam. With 33,000+ employees in 88 offices across 30 countries, we serve 1,100+ clients, including 96 Fortune 500 companies. We believe diversity fuels innovation and strive to create an inclusive workplace where talents of all backgrounds thrive. We welcome expatriates and international professionals to bring fresh perspectives and help shape the future of technology. RESPONSIBILITIES Design and build end-to-end software solutions for testing and AI evaluation — automation frameworks, evaluation pipelines, test data generators, and AI-powered productivity tools used across client delivery projects. Develop AI-driven applications using LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) that automate test case generation, log analysis, defect triage, and result validation. Build the technical foundation of our AI Evaluation Service — pipelines, scoring engines, dashboards, and benchmarking tools that validate LLM-powered applications for global clients. Integrate modern AI capabilities — RAG, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, fine-tuning — into internal QA platforms and client-facing solutions. Analyze current manual testing, automation, and Business Analysis (BA) workflows; design and deliver software solutions that remove bottlenecks through AI. Collaborate with QA leads, AI engineers, and clients to translate requirements into well-architected, shippable software. Continuously research emerging AI tools and frameworks, prototype rapidly, and productionize the ones that prove valuable. Champion engineering best practices — CI/CD, code review, system design, observability — and mentor junior engineers on the team.
requirements_raw: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of shipping production-grade applications or platforms. Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for AI work) and at least one of Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#. Solid software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, system design, API design, CI/CD, automated testing, and code review. Hands-on experience building backend services, REST/gRPC APIs, developer tools, or internal platforms. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and shipping code that integrates LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock). Working knowledge of LLM concepts — prompts, context windows, RAG, embeddings, agentic patterns. Exposure to at least one LLM orchestration framework — LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or similar. Familiarity with software testing concepts — test pyramid, test automation, evaluation methodologies — sufficient to build the right tools for QA teams. You do not need to be a tester, but you must understand what QA needs. Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate technical designs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Japanese communication skills are a strong advantage. Nice to have Prior experience building developer tools, test automation frameworks, evaluation platforms, or AI-powered productivity products. Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate) and embedding models. Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks (DeepEval, Ragas, G-Eval, OpenAI Evals) and an understanding of how to measure LLM faithfulness, relevancy, and toxicity. Cloud AI services experience (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) including deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD for AI workflows. Experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Temporal) or agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Open-source contributions, technical blog writing, or conference talks. Certifications: Cloud AI (AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Azure AI Engineer AI-102, Google Professional ML Engineer), AI Governance (IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001), or AI Testing (ISTQB AI Testing).

title: QA Automation Engineer (Python, TypeScript, AI)
description: At Outpost24, quality isn't a phase at the end of the pipeline — it's built into how we develop software from day one. We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer who wants to own quality end-to-end as an embedded member of a product development team, not as an external gatekeeper, to work in our beautiful office in Hanoi, Vietnam. This is a role for someone who thinks of test automation as a craft, is genuinely excited about AI-assisted development, and wants to shape how a modern engineering team defines and delivers quality. What you'll be doing Embedded directly in a cross-functional product team, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with developers and product owners to build quality in from the start. That means: Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels Contributing to test strategies that balance automation coverage with targeted manual exploration Contributing to requirements and acceptance criteria early — not validating them late Actively participating in our AI-first development programme (ADLC), using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate test creation, coverage analysis, and refactoring Helping establish and evolve quality practices across the team — and sharing what works with the wider engineering organization
requirements_raw: What we're looking for We're open to both experienced engineers and motivated mid-level engineers who are serious about the craft. The strongest candidates will bring: A solid foundation in software testing principles, with a rigorous, detail-oriented mindset Strong test automation skills, ideally with Python3; experience with Cypress or Playwright for UI automation is a plus Experience with one or more of the following languages: TypeScript, Python 3, Golang, or Java Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development tools — not just openness, but curiosity and initiative in applying them Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams Cyber security domain knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement Clear written and spoken English A collaborative, humble attitude and a habit of continuous learning

title: Kỹ sư phát triển Xiaozhi ESP32
description: Galaxy Education là công ty hoạt động lĩnh vực giáo dục trực tuyến. Hiện tại, Galaxy Education vận hành các thương hiệu sản phẩm ICAN, Hệ thống giáo dục Học Mãi (HOCMAI), Đơn vị đào tạo công nghệ thông tin trực tuyến FUNiX và đang tích cực mở rộng thêm các sản phẩm khác. Galaxy Education đang tìm kiếm lập trình viên có kinh nghiệm thực tế với hệ sinh thái Xiaozhi ESP32 để tham gia triển khai và phát triển sản phẩm AI trên nền tảng này. Triển khai và cấu hình firmware Xiaozhi ESP32 trên thiết bị. Cài đặt, vận hành và triển khai hệ thống xiaozhi-esp-server. Tùy biến firmware và server để đáp ứng các yêu cầu nghiệp vụ của dự án. Phát triển các tính năng mới và cải tiến các tính năng hiện có. Phân tích, xử lý lỗi và tối ưu hiệu năng của hệ thống. Phối hợp với đội ngũ kỹ thuật để tích hợp Xiaozhi ESP32 với các dịch vụ và nền tảng khác. Viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và hỗ trợ triển khai lên môi trường production.
requirements_raw: Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Xiaozhi ESP32. Thành thạo phát triển và debug trên nền tảng ESP32. Có kinh nghiệm triển khai hoặc tùy biến xiaozhi-esp-server. Thành thạo Git và môi trường Linux. Có khả năng đọc hiểu mã nguồn và phát triển tính năng mới trên nền tảng mã nguồn mở. Có kỹ năng phân tích và xử lý sự cố tốt. Có khả năng làm việc độc lập và giao tiếp hiệu quả với nhóm từ xa.

title: Senior IT Security Solution Officer
description: 1. Job Purpose: Ensure that approved IT security policies, rules and/or configurations are implemented across MB Life IT security systems and its Infrastructure. Ensure that all security and/or monitoring software, computers, firewalls, servers, devices, appliances, and related IT infrastructure are up to date and configured based on existing MB Life corporate security rules, standard policies and procedures. Understand the security context and operational specifics of the BFSI industry, especially the integration and security protection of the core insurance system. Ensure effective implementation of IT security practices within cloud environments (AWS, O365…). This role requires experience in the application of AI in cybersecurity operations such as threat detection, anomaly analysis, system monitoring, and automation. 2. Key Responsibilities: Ensures appropriate MB Life systems and/or devices are properly configured, updated and working appropriately to detect potential threats and security incidents. Overseas and monitors the system security operations (cyber and internal) such as user account management, network vulnerability scanning, virus database update/scanning and other security measures (detailed below) are performed in accordance with existing MB Life standard policies and procedures. Detection of anomalies, cyber threats and fraudulent use of computers and computer systems. Security electronic communication (email and social media); Protection of personal data and privacy. Secure IT development with regards to MB Life business applications Data masking, encryption, security testing, certification, digital signatures and Public Key Infrastructure Provides support, education and training for all employees in terms of IT Security risk awareness within the organization. Performs audits, reviews, analyses and report submission of security log files as described in approved IT security policies. Participates in the review of investigations after breaches or incidents, including impact analysis and recommendations for avoiding similar vulnerabilities. Provides technical support, education and training to all employees in terms of IT Security risk awareness within the organization. Provides technical support and/or recommendation on IT security technology that would help align MB Life with the latest technology and industry standards.
requirements_raw: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security or a related technical field. At least 3 years solid IT experience with actual hands-on experience in IT Security operations and monitoring using top of the line technology solutions. Practical experience or familiarity with security operations in the BFSI sector, especially life insurance sector is a significant advantage. Proven experience managing cybersecurity in cloud-based infrastructures (especially AWS, O365…). Experience or involvement in AI-based applications in cybersecurity, including automated threat detection, anomaly detection, or log analysis.

title: Senior Manager, Business Ownership (Product & Growth)
description: MoMo is looking for a business owner who can take a product vertical and run it end-to-end — strategy, product, and growth — not just manage a workstream inside it. You build and ship the product, and you own the metrics that prove it's working. This is structured as a track toward full business ownership: managers who deliver against the product and growth mandate progress toward owning a wider vertical or business unit, with P&L-level scope and visibility. We're not looking for someone to run a single function well. We're looking for someone who can be hands-on in product and rigorous enough to own a number. Key Responsibilities: Business Ownership Own the vertical's growth and business targets (e.g. MAU, GMV, revenue, or other core metrics). Take end-to-end accountability for outcomes — not just delivery of tasks or features. Product Leadership Define and own the product roadmap for the vertical, aligned to business goals and user needs. Drive product discovery, feature prioritization based on user research, data, and competitive insight. Stay hands-on through the build cycle — working with Product from spec to launch, not handing off after requirements. Growth & Performance Define the KPIs that matter, diagnose funnel or performance issues, and design experiments (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to improve activation, retention, or conversion. Use data and analytics to make growth levers (incentives, product changes, channel mix) work together rather than in isolation. Cross-functional & Team Leadership Build and develop a team, with clear growth paths for each member. Lead and influence stakeholders across Tech, Risk, Legal, Marketing, Finance, and other functions — through influence, not just reporting lines. Represent the business in cross-functional and leadership-level working groups.
requirements_raw: Must have 8+ years of experience in Product, Growth, or a Business/GM role within a complex, cross-functional environment. Direct ownership of at least one business or product metric (e.g. activation, retention, GMV, revenue), with concrete, presentable results — ideally including P&L or P&L-adjacent ownership. Experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, or platform/marketplace businesses. Exposure to data-driven growth techniques (segmentation, experimentation, A/B testing at scale). What Makes This Role Different: Most product roles optimize a roadmap. Most growth roles optimize a funnel. This role is for someone who doesn't want to pick one — who can be hands-on in shipping product and still be the person who owns whether the number moves, and who's ultimately measured on the health of the business, not just the workstream.

title: Junior Backend Developer (Python / APIs)
description: Entry-level backend developer who will help build and maintain the Python-based services powering the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its re-sellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP). You will work closely with the Tech Lead and Middle Fullstack Developer (WordPress + Python) to implement FastAPI endpoints, support Grok Voice Agent integration, work with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) , external data sources, Stripe payments, and other integrations — under guidance from senior engineers in a fast-moving startup environment. Current engineering phase (May 2026) Production business logic and many APIs still run on the WordPress plugin (/wp-json/qr/v3). New Python services are added using a strangler-fig approach: no big-bang rewrite . Your work often extends or bridges existing behaviour while we build FastAPI services (CCI, voice proxy, ETL helpers). Web clients use React/Next.js ; mobile uses Flutter — you integrate with both via APIs, not only a greenfield backend. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) — a voice-first, multilingual platform that connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Implement and maintain clean REST API endpoints using FastAPI (or Flask where appropriate) based on specifications and OpenAPI docs from the Tech Lead. Support strangler migration : respect backward compatibility for WordPress REST where features still live in PHP; add or extend /api/v1/* Python routes without breaking live tenants. Integrate external APIs and real-time services — including Grok Voice Agent WebSocket proxying (under supervision), Stripe Connect webhooks and payment flows, and third-party data sources ( CBS, Kadaster, PDOK , etc.) — using Python HTTP clients and SDKs. Write and maintain simple, efficient database queries ( PostgreSQL via Cloud SQL) and schema migrations under supervision. Assist with logging, monitoring , error handling, and observability ( Cloud Logging, Sentry ). Write unit and integration tests ; help document APIs, internal services, and tool functions callable by Grok . Participate actively in code reviews , follow team standards ( ruff/black, mypy, pre-commit where adopted), and learn modern Python backend patterns. Collaborate with Middle Fullstack , Junior WordPress/PHP , UX , and Data Scientist (part-time) to ensure smooth end-to-end flows (voice → API → database → response).
requirements_raw: 1–2 years of backend development experience (internships, freelance projects, personal/open-source work, or strong portfolio are fully acceptable). Solid Python fundamentals (functions, modules, virtual environments, packaging, async/await basics). Basic experience building HTTP APIs (REST/JSON) and working with external services via requests , httpx , or SDKs. Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, simple joins, indexes) and relational databases. Familiarity with Git (branching, pull requests, commit hygiene) and collaborative workflows. Strong willingness to learn quickly, accept constructive feedback, and thrive in a small, supportive team. Good English communication skills (written & spoken) for team discussions, documentation, and reading technical resources. Nice to have Exposure to FastAPI (preferred), Flask, or Django. Experience with real-time features (WebSockets, LiveKit) or AI/ML API integrations (e.g. Grok, OpenAI, Anthropic). Basic knowledge of PostgreSQL , SQLAlchemy , or async drivers ( asyncpg ). Familiarity with Docker , containerized development, or Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions). Understanding of RESTful design , OpenAPI/Swagger , or basic API security ( JWT , rate limiting). Basic awareness of WordPress REST or PHP (you do not own the plugin, but you may consume or align with its API contracts). Interest in voice AI , marketplaces, or real estate tech.

title: QA Engineer (Tester/ QA QC)
description: As a QAE, you will help to ensure that the product systematically meets and exceeds our users’ expectations. You will contribute by designing & executing the most efficient manual testing strategy to ensure that: 90+% of defects are identified & documented before reaching the end-users Exclusive of defects that can only be detected in the client environment All features behave as they should (i.e no regression) For all the releases supported All new features are evaluated from an End User perspective Understand users and create relevant testing scenarios Proactively suggest improvements for our product and methodologies Report what does not work well or is broken, even if not part of the current assignments

title: Backend Engineer (Grok Voice Agent)
description: Role summary Senior-leaning backend engineer who owns the real-time voice layer behind the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its re-sellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP). You build and operate the Grok Voice Agent integration — the WebSocket proxy, the tool-calling framework that lets our agent "Q" execute real platform actions (valuations, CRM, vendor matching, workflow state changes, payments), and the text/chat fallback. This is the single most central engineering role in our AI-native vision: voice is the primary interface, not a feature. You work closely with the Tech Lead and the Middle Fullstack Developer, and you set the patterns the Junior Backend Developer and Junior Flutter Developer follow when they consume your APIs. Current engineering phase (May–July 2026) Production today runs on a WordPress plugin with REST /wp-json/qr/v3 and paying Dutch realtor tenants. New Python/FastAPI services are added alongside using a strangler-fig approach — no big-bang rewrite. The voice track is net-new : you build the FastAPI voice proxy and tool endpoints from the ground up, while respecting the existing API contracts and multi-tenant model ( organization_id , roles/capabilities). Web clients use React/Next.js; mobile uses Flutter (LiveKit on the device) — both consume your real-time layer via APIs. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM). This voice-first, multilingual platform connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Build and maintain the Grok Voice Agent WebSocket proxy in Python/FastAPI: low-latency, streaming, reconnect-safe, with LiveKit integration points for the Flutter mobile client. Design a clean, versioned "tools" API that the voice agent can call to execute real actions — CRM operations, vendor matching, property valuations, workflow/order state changes, and payment flows — with strict input validation and per-tenant authorization on every call. Implement authentication and session management for voice sessions: JWT-based auth middleware, tenant context propagation ( organization_id , roles), session lifecycle, and a robust text/chat fallback for when voice is unavailable. Productionize the first 8–10 core voice commands mapping to real realtor actions, end-to-end (intent → tool call → backend mutation → spoken/visual confirmation). Integrate external AI/LLM and real-time services (Grok primary; Anthropic/OpenAI where relevant) and coordinate with the Middle Fullstack Developer on WP-side tool endpoints during transition. Handle observability and reliability : structured logging, tracing on the streaming path, error handling, idempotency, and graceful degradation (Cloud Logging, Sentry). Write OpenAPI specs, tool-function docs, and developer handoff notes so the Junior Backend, Junior Flutter, and Next.js engineers can consume and extend the voice layer safely. Enforce security and privacy on the voice path: no PII in logs/metadata where avoidable, GDPR-aware transcript handling, access control on sensitive tools (payments, payouts). Participate in code reviews, follow team standards (ruff/black, mypy, pre-commit where adopted), and partner with the Tech Lead on architecture and scalability
requirements_raw: Required skills & experience 3–5 years of backend engineering , with proven delivery of production services. Strong Python (FastAPI preferred; async/await, packaging, testing) — required. Hands-on real-time systems experience : WebSockets, streaming, low-latency APIs, connection lifecycle, and backpressure handling. Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs (Grok, Anthropic, OpenAI) or voice platforms (LiveKit, Twilio, Vonage, or similar). Solid understanding of authentication and session state (JWT/OAuth, secure token handling) and cloud deployment concepts (containers, serverless; GCP a plus). Comfortable designing and documenting JSON/REST APIs and OpenAPI specs. Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and safe schema/migration practices under supervision of the Tech Lead. Good English communication (written and spoken) for documentation, team discussions, and collaboration with the Dutch CTO and Tech Lead. Nice to have Experience building tool-calling / function-calling frameworks for LLM agents. Familiarity with LiveKit , WebRTC, or audio streaming pipelines. Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS (tenant isolation, RLS, configurable rules). Stripe Connect / payments integration awareness (you may expose payment tools to the agent). Experience with Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub) or similar. CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), Docker, monitoring (Sentry). Interest in voice UX , multilingual systems (Dutch & English), or real estate / proptech. Basic awareness of WordPress REST or PHP (you do not own the plugin, but you align with its API contracts during transition).
